title: Fathom for Godot 4 is live: 48 species and 12 seas, drawn in code
html:
Fathom is live for Godot 4: one node that turns a 2D scene into an underwater level, with 48 species in 12 families and 12 seas, every one drawn by code when your scene starts. No image file ships in the addon.

What it does

  • FathomSea2D lays down the light: reds go first, the water's colour closes in, shafts fall, marine snow drifts, nets of light crawl over your rock. In a side view, depth is read per pixel from the world, so the light falls as the player sinks.
  • Your TileMapLayer is the sea floor. Side on, kelp grows from the top of each cell with open water above it, crabs walk on it and fish steer round it. Top down, a town map goes under water with no other change.
  • 12 seas, each with its own drawn backdrop, floor, plants, light and life, from Sunlit Shallows to the Midnight Zone, a Vent Field, a Shipwreck and a Drowned Temple.
  • Life that reacts to your player: shoals open a hole and close behind, reef fish bolt, a garden eel sinks into the sand, an octopus jets away and leaves ink. A lamp gives colours back around whoever carries it.
  • FathomSchool2D places one species by hand. FathomDive is a splash and a sink with a signal at the midpoint. FathomAir is an air meter drawn as a column of bubbles.

Tested

  • Every preset photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility: 120 frames, zero engine errors, all 60 distinct.
  • The shipped zip installed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project under both renderers: a level built from tiles, a top down map, behaviours measured against a control, and the light measured on a flat grey world.
  • 7 attacks, including a path with spaces and non Latin characters, two hundred creatures at once, a third renderer, bad inputs and a renamed addon folder; 479 Readme claims checked against the shipped files.
  • Looking at the pictures found what no counter could. Caustics were a cracked pane of glass over open water, every species photograph showed a speck instead of the specimen because the preview list had slipped out of step, and a temple could not be found in its own sea. The gate passed all of them. All were fixed before release.

Free lite

The page carries a free MIT lite: 12 of the 60 presets, the same nodes, and a demo.

Where this line stands: 22 Godot packs live from this studio, 1 purchase so far (read from the store the day this went live).

Disclosure: the scripts, shaders and demo were written with AI; the demo's town tiles come from our own generated tilesets and the cover illustration was made by an AI image model.
